motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: 160ms button background and border state transitions; suppressed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The explicit next action in the current task state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; padding:0.6875rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-action,#8a0a14); color:var(--color-surface,#fff); font:600 1rem/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-action-hover,#680911); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:#51070d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus,#0b6a62); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:48px; padding:0.6875rem 1.125rem; border:1px solid #83918e; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-surface,#fff); color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); font:600 1rem/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#edf2f0; border-color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#dfe8e4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus,#0b6a62); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Lower-emphasis account switch below invitation acceptance.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-text">Sign out to use another account</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-text { display:block; min-height:44px; padding:.75rem 0; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-action,#8a0a14); font:.9375rem/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color:var(--color-action-hover,#680911); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus,#0b6a62); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Email Field
components.description: Labeled email entry with short invitation guidance.
components.html: Use the address on your invitation.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.5rem; color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); font:600 1rem/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-email { display:block; width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:.6875rem .875rem; border:1px solid #83918e; border-radius:var(--radius-control,6px); background:var(--color-surface,#fff); color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); caret-color:var(--color-action,#8a0a14); font:1rem/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus,#0b6a62); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-email:disabled { background:var(--color-canvas,#f6f7f6); } .ds-field-help { margin:.5rem 0 0; color:var(--color-muted,#53616a); font:.875rem/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Compact CRC identity and congregation attribution.
components.html: CRC B’nei MitzvahCentral Reform Congregation
components.css: .ds-masthead { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1rem; padding:1.75rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule,#d5dcda); font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-brand { color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); font-size:1.125rem; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.02em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-brand:hover { color:var(--color-action-hover,#680911); } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus,#0b6a62); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-congregation { color:var(--color-muted,#53616a); font-size:.875rem; }

components.name: Invitation Details
components.description: Explicit role and target review before acceptance.
components.css: .ds-invite { margin:1.75rem 0; color:var(--color-ink,#222c35); font:1rem/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-invite>div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:5rem minmax(0,1fr); gap:1rem; margin-top:.75rem; } .ds-invite dt { color:var(--color-muted,#53616a); } .ds-invite dd { margin:0; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview: The implemented entry surface uses a white working field, legible ink, a restrained burgundy action, and precise rules. The page leads with the reading as its destination while its neighboring task area reports actual access and invitation state. This is the initial authentication and invitation slice; a Hebrew passage and its practice tools have not been implemented or visually specified by this file. The current controls feel familiar and deliberate. Spacing creates the hierarchy, and text explains state without ornamental imagery.
keyCharacteristics: A flat white field with fine rules and a compact congregation masthead.
A reading-first introduction beside a live task area on wide screens.
Clear, touch-sized controls and a single-column phone layout.
Explicit role and invitation details before access changes.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces an explicit label or message; role and invitation state remain understandable without color.

rules.name: The Reading Type Rule
rules.body: Hebrew reading requires its own verified vowel and cantillation rendering when actual licensed content is implemented. The current `[lang="he"]` selector establishes right-to-left direction and mark features, but no Hebrew passage or compiled Hebrew font is present yet.

rules.name: The Adjacent Task Rule
rules.body: Keep the current action or access state next to the introduction on wide screens, and immediately after it on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Open Surface Rule
rules.body: Use line weight and spacing to separate content; this entry surface has no shadow vocabulary.

dos: **Do** keep current access and invitation outcomes explicit in headings, labels, and recovery copy.
**Do** preserve a readable one-column flow and touch-sized actions on phones.
**Do** use the restrained burgundy for action and teal for focus or confirmed-role emphasis.
donts: **Don't** imply an unimplemented reading workspace or invent passage content in the entry surface.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate role or acceptance state.
**Don't** add decorative depth to this flat entry system without an implemented reason.
